; Extending the first hps (homogeneous parallel server) queuing model
; Kanageshwaran Dhakshinamoorthy
; CSC148 student, Fall 2025
; This model extends the in-class FIRST hps (Module P2): each arriving cj requests a random 16 servers
; using transaction parameters (no SAVEVALUE), compares two service scenarios (load-free vs. load-dependent),
; and creates histograms of customer residence time (w_residence) and free servers at service start (free_srv_hist).
; Time unit (t.u.) = 1 (arbitrary)
; Exact START command used: START 25000
; Model termination condition: simulation ends when the 25,000th customer transaction completes; each
; TERMINATE 1 in cj reduces tc by 1; the initializer transaction init_hps TERMINATE does not decrement tc.
; Additional run details: Ai ~ Exponential(mean = 1.0 t.u.); Service ~ Exponential(mean = 5.0 t.u.);
; load-dependent service adds sc = 0.12 * (r$hpsName)^(2.19) / nps (or cubic approximation if ^2.19 unsupported).
; hps creation/initialization: hpsName STORAGE <nps>; init_hps GENERATE 0,,0,1,1 then ENTER hpsName,<nps> at t=0.
; Server use protocol: TEST   GE   s$hpsName,p$p_srvReq ? LEAVE hpsName,p$p_srvReq ? service ? ENTER hpsName,p$p_srvReq.
; Seeds fixed across all runs per assignment: RN1 = 123456, RN2 = 789123.
; --- Parameters ---
ai_mean	 EQU	 1.0
srv_mean	 EQU	 5.0
num_servers	 EQU	 64
coeff	 EQU	 0.12
expPower	 EQU	 2.19
p_srvReq	 EQU	 1
p_srvDur	 EQU	 2
Seed1	 EQU	 123456
Seed2	 EQU	 789123
; --- Seed random numbers ---
RMULT	 ,Seed1
RMULT	 ,Seed2
; --- Create and power-up hps ---
hpsName	 STORAGE	 64
init_hps	 GENERATE	 0,,0,1,1
	 ENTER	 hpsName,64
	 TERMINATE
; --- Customer process ---
cj	 GENERATE	 (Exponential(1,0,ai_mean)),,,25000
	 QUEUE	 q_residence
	 ASSIGN	 p_srvReq,(RN2@6 + 1)
	 QUEUE	 q_wait
TEST	 GE	 s$hpsName,p$p_srvReq
	 QUEUE	 q_service
	 LEAVE	 hpsName,p$p_srvReq
	 DEPART	 q_wait
	 TABULATE	 free_srv_hist
;   --- Service time (choose one) ---
;ASSIGN	 p_srvDur,(Exponential(1,0,srv_mean))                     ; load-free			
ASSIGN	 p_srvDur,(Exponential(1,0,srv_mean) + 0.12#(r$hpsName^2.19)/64)	 ;load-dependent
	 ADVANCE	 p$p_srvDur
	 ENTER	 hpsName,p$p_srvReq
	 DEPART	 q_service
	 DEPART	 q_residence
	 TABULATE	 w_residence
	 TERMINATE	 1
; --- Tables ---
w_residence	 TABLE	 M1,0.5,0.5,30
free_srv_hist	 TABLE	 s$hpsName,1,1,64

import simpy
import numpy as np
import random
import sys
import pdb

# Required for plotDisplay on IRT servers
sys.path.append('/home/college/mitchell/simpy3demos')
import plotDisplay as plotSrc

# ---------- GLOBAL SEED ----------
seedName = 123456  # <-- choose any 6+ digit seed you want
np.random.seed(seedName)


# =======================================================
# CLASS: Warehouse (W)
# =======================================================
class W:
    def __init__(self, env, name):
        self.env = env
        self.name = name
        self.finishedSites = {}  # dictionary of completed CO sites

        print(f"Created Warehouse instance named  {self.name}  at time  {env.now}  seed is {seedName}")

    # Inventory initialization placeholder (not used in h4)
    def initInventoryForCO(self, coObj, initialAmount):
        pass

    # ---------- Reporting Process ----------
    def numDoneReport(self):
        yield self.env.timeout(0)

        print("... Starting numDoneReport")
        reportInterval = 1  # check every 1 hour

        while True:
            yield self.env.timeout(reportInterval)

            print(f"### Sites that are finished at time  {self.env.now} ::  {self.finishedSites}")

            # Stop after all 5 CO sites have finished
            if len(self.finishedSites) == 5:
                break

        print(f"\nAll COk have finished at t={self.env.now}.")
        print("... numDoneReport finished execution at time: ", self.env.now)


# =======================================================
# CLASS: Contractor-Only Site (CO)
# =======================================================
class CO:
    def __init__(self, env, name, initialInventory, warehouse):
        self.env = env
        self.name = name
        self.I = initialInventory
        self.warehouse = warehouse

        print(f"    Created CO instance  {self.name}  with init I(t) value  {self.I}")

    # ---------- Sale Process ----------
    def doSale(self):
        print(f"Starting doSale for CO  {self.name}  at time  {self.env.now}")

        RP = 50  # restock (termination) threshold
        global salesSizeData

        while True:

            # Random delay between sales: 1 or 2 hours
            delay = int(np.random.uniform(1, 3))
            yield self.env.timeout(delay)

            # Random sale size: 30–49 widgets
            saleSize = int(np.random.uniform(30, 50))
            salesSizeData.append(saleSize)

            # Decrease inventory
            self.I -= saleSize

            # Required event print
            print(f"Site  {self.name}  has I(t) value  {self.I}  at time  {self.env.now}")

            # Stop once inventory drops below restock threshold RP
            if self.I < RP:
                print(f"  %%% CO  {self.name}  finished sales at time  {self.env.now}")
                self.warehouse.finishedSites[self.name] = "done"
                break


# =======================================================
# MAIN SIMULATION
# =======================================================
def main():
    print("\n================= START SIMULATION =================\n")

    global salesSizeData
    salesSizeData = []  # All sale sizes collected for histogram

    env = simpy.Environment()

    # Create warehouse
    warehouse = W(env, "W1")

    # Create 5 CO sites with required initial inventory
    initVals = [250, 250, 250, 250, 500]
    CO_list = []

    for i in range(5):
        coName = f"CO{i}"
        coObj = CO(env, coName, initVals[i], warehouse)
        CO_list.append(coObj)
        env.process(coObj.doSale())

    # Start reporting process
    env.process(warehouse.numDoneReport())

    # Run simulation until warehouse reporting ends
    env.run()

    print("\n===== Final Accounting =====")

    # Total widgets sold
    totalSalesAmount = sum(salesSizeData)
    print("Total sales amounts over all COk was ", totalSalesAmount)

    # Number of sale events
    print("Number of elements in salesSizeData list is ", len(salesSizeData))

    # Histogram Plot
    bins = 20  # Enough to cover values 30–49
    plotSrc.plotDisplay(
        salesSizeData,
        "Sale Sizes Histogram",
        "Possible Sale Sizes",
        "Frequency",
        bins
    )

    print("\n================== END SIMULATION ==================\n")


# =======================================================
# Start Program
# =======================================================
if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

import simpy
import random
import sys
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

sys.path.append('/home/college/mitchell/simpy3demos')
import linePlot as lp

s = 1234567890
random.seed(s)
RP = 100
END = 49
dh = False

class W:
    def __init__(self, e, n):
        self.e = e
        self.n = n
        self.c = {}
        self.ev = {}
        self.so = [0]*10
        self.tr = 0
        self.ti = 0
        self.cn = list(range(1,11))

        print("Python version & info:: ", sys.version)
        print()
        print("Your 10-digit seed")
        print(s)
        print("Your 10-digit seed")
        print(s)
        print()
        print("Running class Warehouse __init__ fcn at time ",
              self.e.now, " for warehouse ", self.n,
              " // random pkg seed is ", s)

        self.h = self.e.process(self.ih())
        self.e.process(self.rr())

    def reg(self, o):
        self.c[o.l] = o

    def add(self, k):
        self.so[k-1] += 1

    def ih(self):
        while True:
            try:
                yield self.e.timeout(1000)
            except simpy.Interrupt as z:
                self.ti += 1
                L = z.cause
                k = int(L[2:])
                p = f"CO {k}"
                print(f"    III  {p}  is interrupting warehouse w at time  {self.e.now}")
                print(f"Start scheduling & delivering restock to {p}  at time  {self.e.now}")
                if L not in self.ev:
                    self.ev[L] = self.e.event()
                self.e.process(self.rs(L))

    def rs(self, L):
        d = int(random.uniform(1,4))
        yield self.e.timeout(d)
        o = self.c[L]
        self.tr += 1
        o.I = o.mx
        k = o.k
        p = f"CO {k}"
        if o.st:
            print(f"  CRAS  {p}  completed re-stock AFTER stockout; resume w. I(t)=  {o.I}  at time  {self.e.now}")
        else:
            print(f"    CNS {p}  completed NON-STOCKOUT re-stocking, resuming w. I(t)=  {o.I}  at time  {self.e.now}")
        if L in self.ev:
            self.ev.pop(L).succeed()
        o.rr = False

    def rr(self):
        while True:
            yield self.e.timeout(10)
            P = sorted([f"CO{int(x[2:])}" for x in self.ev.keys()],
                       key=lambda y: int(y[2:]))
            print(f"    RRR  Report - The COks with pending restocks at time  {self.e.now} ::  {P}")
            if self.e.now >= END:
                break


class C:
    def __init__(self, e, k, I, w, sd):
        self.e = e
        self.k = k
        self.l = f"CO{k}"
        self.I = I
        self.mx = I
        self.rp = RP
        self.w = w
        self.sd = sd
        self.rr = False
        self.st = False
        w.reg(self)

        print(f"    Created CO instance  {self.l}  with init I(t) value  {self.I}")
        if self.sd == 0:
            print(f"Starting doOrders() for CO {self.k}  at time  {self.e.now}  with Init inventory  {self.I}  and RP  {self.rp}")

    def run(self):
        global dh
        if self.sd > 0:
            yield self.e.timeout(self.sd)
            if not dh:
                print()
                print("COks that are beginning a deferred startup")
                print()
                print(" at t=15")
                dh = True
            print(f"Starting doOrders() for CO {self.k}  at time  {self.e.now}  with Init inventory  {self.I}  and RP  {self.rp}")

        while True:
            yield self.e.timeout(int(random.uniform(1,3)))
            v = int(random.uniform(40,61))

            if self.I - v < 0:
                p = f"CO {self.k}"
                print(f"    SSS - Stockout occured for {p}  at time  {self.e.now}")
                self.st = True
                self.w.add(self.k)
                ev = self.w.ev[self.l]
                yield ev
                self.st = False
                continue

            self.I -= v
            p = f"CO {self.k}"
            print(f"{p}  I(t) level is  {self.I}  at time  {self.e.now}")

            if self.I < self.rp and not self.rr:
                self.rr = True
                self.w.h.interrupt(self.l)
                yield self.e.timeout(0)


def main():
    print("\n================= START SIMULATION =================\n")

    e = simpy.Environment()
    w = W(e,"WH1")

    print("Creating  10  CO stores, some of which start orders after a delay")

    for k in range(1,11):
        I = 300 if k in (1,10) else 200
        sd = 15 if k in (5,6) else 0
        o = C(e,k,I,w,sd)
        e.process(o.run())

    e.run(until=END)

    print(f"Finished run at model time  {END} \n")
    print(" Summary Report\n")

    T = sum(w.so)
    print("Grand total number of stockouts over all COk  ", T)
    print()
    print("Required run Summary reporting")
    print("Total number of restocks completed & interrupts thrown by all COk  ",
          f"{w.tr}  &  {w.ti}")
    print("Number of stockouts, by COk number  ", w.so)
    print()

    lp.linePlot(
        plotRef=plt,
        varRange=w.cn,
        varValues=w.so
    )
    plt.show()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""
Name: Kanageshwaran Dhakshinamoorthy
Course: CSC 148 - Programming with SimPy (Fall 2025)
Instructor: Prof. Mitchell
Assignment: Homework 5 - MI Model with Restocking
Date: December 2025

Description:
  This script extends the Homework-4 MI model to include restocking.
  Ten Contractor-Only sites (CO1-CO10) execute sales. When inventory
  drops below RP = 100, the CO interrupts the Warehouse. The Warehouse
  schedules restocking via a shared event. If a sale would cause a
  stockout, the CO suspends until the restock completes.

  Required message sequences:
    • CO creation messages
    • doOrders() starts
    • Sales with I(t)
    • III messages
    • SSS (stockout)
    • CRAS / CNS (restock result)
    • RRR reports every 10 time units

  Runs until model time 49.
"""

import simpy
import random
import sys
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Instructor directory
sys.path.append('/home/college/mitchell/simpy3demos')
import linePlot as lp

# ---- Global ----
randomSeed = 1234567890
random.seed(randomSeed)
RP = 100
SIM_END_TIME = 49

# To ensure the CO5/CO6 header prints only once
printed_deferred_header = False


# ==========================================================
# Warehouse Class
# ==========================================================
class Warehouse:

    def __init__(self, env, name):
        self.env = env
        self.name = name

        self.co_dict = {}
        self.se_dict = {}

        self.stockoutCounts = [0] * 10
        self.totalRestocks = 0
        self.totalInterrupts = 0
        self.CONum = list(range(1, 11))

        print("Python version & info:: ", sys.version)
        print()
        print("Your 10-digit seed")
        print(randomSeed)
        print("Your 10-digit seed")
        print(randomSeed)
        print()

        print("Running class Warehouse __init__ fcn at time ",
              self.env.now,
              " for warehouse ",
              self.name,
              " // random pkg seed is ",
              randomSeed)

        # Start the interrupt handler
        self.restockHandlerProc = self.env.process(self.restockInterruptHandler())

        # Start periodic RRR reporter
        self.env.process(self.pendingRestocksReporter())

    # Register CO
    def registerCO(self, co_obj):
        self.co_dict[co_obj.label] = co_obj

    # CO recorded stockout
    def recordStockout(self, number):
        self.stockoutCounts[number - 1] += 1

    # Interrupt handler
    def restockInterruptHandler(self):
        while True:
            try:
                yield self.env.timeout(1000)
            except simpy.Interrupt as e:
                self.totalInterrupts += 1
                co_label = e.cause   # "CO3"
                num = int(co_label[2:])
                pretty = f"CO {num}"

                print(f"    III  {pretty}  is interrupting warehouse w at time  {self.env.now}")
                print(f"Start scheduling & delivering restock to {pretty}  at time  {self.env.now}")

                # Create shared event if needed
                if co_label not in self.se_dict:
                    self.se_dict[co_label] = self.env.event()

                self.env.process(self.doRestock(co_label))

    # Restock process
    def doRestock(self, co_label):
        delay = int(random.uniform(1, 4))
        yield self.env.timeout(delay)

        co = self.co_dict[co_label]
        self.totalRestocks += 1
        co.I = co.maxInv

        num = co.number
        pretty = f"CO {num}"

        if co.inStockout:
            print(f"  CRAS  {pretty}  completed re-stock AFTER stockout; resume w. I(t)=  {co.I}  at time  {self.env.now}")
        else:
            print(f"    CNS {pretty}  completed NON-STOCKOUT re-stocking, resuming w. I(t)=  {co.I}  at time  {self.env.now}")

        if co_label in self.se_dict:
            self.se_dict.pop(co_label).succeed()

        co.restockRequested = False

    # RRR reporter
    def pendingRestocksReporter(self):
        while True:
            yield self.env.timeout(10)
            pending = sorted([f"CO{int(lbl[2:])}" for lbl in self.se_dict.keys()],
                             key=lambda x: int(x[2:]))
            print(f"    RRR  Report - The COks with pending restocks at time  {self.env.now} ::  {pending}")
            if self.env.now >= SIM_END_TIME:
                break


# ==========================================================
# Contractor-Only Class
# ==========================================================
class CO:

"""
Name: Kanageshwaran Dhakshinamoorthy
Course: CSC 148 - Programming with SimPy (Fall 2025)
Instructor: Prof. Mitchell
Assignment: Homework 5 - MI Model with Restocking
Date: December 2025

Description:
  This script extends the Homework-4 MI model to include restocking.
  Ten Contractor-Only sites (CO1-CO10) execute sales. When inventory
  drops below RP = 100, the CO interrupts the Warehouse. The Warehouse
  schedules restocking via a shared event. If a sale would cause a
  stockout, the CO suspends until the restock completes.

  Required message sequences:
    • CO creation messages
    • doOrders() starts
    • Sales with I(t)
    • III messages
    • SSS (stockout)
    • CRAS / CNS (restock result)
    • RRR reports every 10 time units

  Runs until model time 49.
"""

import simpy
import random
import sys
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Instructor directory
sys.path.append('/home/college/mitchell/simpy3demos')
import linePlot as lp

# ---- Global ----
randomSeed = 1234567890
random.seed(randomSeed)
RP = 100
SIM_END_TIME = 49

# To ensure the CO5/CO6 header prints only once
printed_deferred_header = False


# ==========================================================
# Warehouse Class
# ==========================================================
class Warehouse:

    def __init__(self, env, name):
        self.env = env
        self.name = name

        self.co_dict = {}
        self.se_dict = {}

        self.stockoutCounts = [0] * 10
        self.totalRestocks = 0
        self.totalInterrupts = 0
        self.CONum = list(range(1, 11))

        print("Python version & info:: ", sys.version)
        print()
        print("Your 10-digit seed")
        print(randomSeed)
        print("Your 10-digit seed")
        print(randomSeed)
        print()

        print("Running class Warehouse __init__ fcn at time ",
              self.env.now,
              " for warehouse ",
              self.name,
              " // random pkg seed is ",
              randomSeed)

        # Start the interrupt handler
        self.restockHandlerProc = self.env.process(self.restockInterruptHandler())

        # Start periodic RRR reporter
        self.env.process(self.pendingRestocksReporter())

    # Register CO
    def registerCO(self, co_obj):
        self.co_dict[co_obj.label] = co_obj

    # CO recorded stockout
    def recordStockout(self, number):
        self.stockoutCounts[number - 1] += 1

    # Interrupt handler
    def restockInterruptHandler(self):
        while True:
            try:
                yield self.env.timeout(1000)
            except simpy.Interrupt as e:
                self.totalInterrupts += 1
                co_label = e.cause   # "CO3"
                num = int(co_label[2:])
                pretty = f"CO {num}"

                print(f"    III  {pretty}  is interrupting warehouse w at time  {self.env.now}")
                print(f"Start scheduling & delivering restock to {pretty}  at time  {self.env.now}")

                # Create shared event if needed
                if co_label not in self.se_dict:
                    self.se_dict[co_label] = self.env.event()

                self.env.process(self.doRestock(co_label))

    # Restock process
    def doRestock(self, co_label):
        delay = int(random.uniform(1, 4))
        yield self.env.timeout(delay)

        co = self.co_dict[co_label]
        self.totalRestocks += 1
        co.I = co.maxInv

        num = co.number
        pretty = f"CO {num}"

        if co.inStockout:
            print(f"  CRAS  {pretty}  completed re-stock AFTER stockout; resume w. I(t)=  {co.I}  at time  {self.env.now}")
        else:
            print(f"    CNS {pretty}  completed NON-STOCKOUT re-stocking, resuming w. I(t)=  {co.I}  at time  {self.env.now}")

        if co_label in self.se_dict:
            self.se_dict.pop(co_label).succeed()

        co.restockRequested = False

    # RRR reporter
    def pendingRestocksReporter(self):
        while True:
            yield self.env.timeout(10)
            pending = sorted([f"CO{int(lbl[2:])}" for lbl in self.se_dict.keys()],
                             key=lambda x: int(x[2:]))
            print(f"    RRR  Report - The COks with pending restocks at time  {self.env.now} ::  {pending}")
            if self.env.now >= SIM_END_TIME:
                break


# ==========================================================
# Contractor-Only Class
# ==========================================================
class CO:

    def __init__(self, env, number, initInv, warehouse, startDelay):
        self.env = env
        self.number = number
        self.label = f"CO{number}"
        self.I = initInv
        self.maxInv = initInv
        self.rp = RP

        self.warehouse = warehouse
        self.startDelay = startDelay

        self.restockRequested = False
        self.inStockout = False

        warehouse.registerCO(self)

        print(f"    Created CO instance  {self.label}  with init I(t) value  {self.I}")

        if self.startDelay == 0:
            print(f"Starting doOrders() for CO {self.number}  at time  {self.env.now}  with Init inventory  {self.I}  and RP  {self.rp}")

    def doOrders(self):
        global printed_deferred_header

        if self.startDelay > 0:
            yield self.env.timeout(self.startDelay)

            if not printed_deferred_header:
                print()
                print("COks that are beginning a deferred startup")
                print()
                print(" at t=15")
                printed_deferred_header = True

            print(f"Starting doOrders() for CO {self.number}  at time  {self.env.now}  with Init inventory  {self.I}  and RP  {self.rp}")

        while True:
            yield self.env.timeout(int(random.uniform(1, 3)))
            sale = int(random.uniform(40, 61))

            if self.I - sale < 0:
                pretty = f"CO {self.number}"
                print(f"    SSS - Stockout occured for {pretty}  at time  {self.env.now}")

                self.inStockout = True
                self.warehouse.recordStockout(self.number)

                se = self.warehouse.se_dict[self.label]
                yield se
                self.inStockout = False
                continue

            self.I -= sale
            pretty = f"CO {self.number}"
            print(f"{pretty}  I(t) level is  {self.I}  at time  {self.env.now}")

            if self.I < self.rp and not self.restockRequested:
                self.restockRequested = True
                self.warehouse.restockHandlerProc.interrupt(self.label)
                yield self.env.timeout(0)


# ==========================================================
# MAIN
# ==========================================================
def main():
    print("\n================= START SIMULATION =================\n")

    env = simpy.Environment()
    warehouse = Warehouse(env, "WH1")

    print("Creating  10  CO stores, some of which start orders after a delay")

    co_list = []
    for k in range(1, 11):
        initInv = 300 if k in (1, 10) else 200
        startDelay = 15 if k in (5, 6) else 0

        co = CO(env, k, initInv, warehouse, startDelay)
        co_list.append(co)
        env.process(co.doOrders())

    env.run(until=SIM_END_TIME)

    print(f"Finished run at model time  {SIM_END_TIME} \n")
    print(" Summary Report\n")

    totalSO = sum(warehouse.stockoutCounts)
    print("Grand total number of stockouts over all COk  ", totalSO)
    print()
    print("Required run Summary reporting")
    print("Total number of restocks completed & interrupts thrown by all COk  ",
          f"{warehouse.totalRestocks}  &  {warehouse.totalInterrupts}")
    print("Number of stockouts, by COk number  ",
          warehouse.stockoutCounts)
    print()

    lp.linePlot(
        plotRef=plt,
        varRange=warehouse.CONum,
        varValues=warehouse.stockoutCounts
    )
    plt.show()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
